results.title: Foreign Affairs Ministry refers 2 interdicted officers to police over illegal passport scheme
results.content: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has referred two of its officers to the Ghana Police Service for further investigations and possible prosecution over their alleged involvement in an illegal Service Passport issuance scheme.

results.title: Aliko Dangote to join President Mahama at Invest Ghana Summit 2026
results.content: Convened by the Ghana Investment Promotion Authority (GIPA), with support from the Ministry of Trade, Agribusiness and Industry; Ghana Export Promotion Authority (GEPA); Bank of Ghana (BoG); Ghana Free Zones Authority (GFZA); National African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) Coordination Office; and the 24-Hour Economy and Accelerated Export Development Programme (24H+), and in partnership with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Finance, the President-led Summit will connect international capital with investment-ready opportunities across manufacturing, agribusiness, infrastructure, energy, logistics, healthcare, mining, tourism, digital technology and the creative economy.

results.title: Ghana ranks 18th in Sub-Saharan Africa in terms of total revenue-to-GDP ratio
results.content: Namibia recorded the highest revenue-to-GDP ratio of 31.3% in Sub-Saharan Africa, followed by Seychelles (30.0%) in 3rd position and Botswana (29.5%) in 4th position.

results.title: When the floods struck, Activa delivered: over GH₵4.7m paid in flood claims as of October 2026
results.content: Following the heavy rains and widespread flooding experienced in Accra and several other parts of Ghana during the 2026 rainy season, Activa International Insurance Ghana demonstrated its commitment to standing by customers when disaster struck. As at 31 October 2026, Activa had paid over GH₵4.7 million in flood-related insurance claims, helping affected customers recover from […]

results.title: 2026 CAF WCL: Ampem Darkoa Ladies suffer group stage exit after defeat to AS FAR
results.content: Ampem Darkoa lost 2-0 to defending champions AS FAR in their final group game, ending hopes of qualifying to the next round.

results.title: 10 illegally issued Service Passports cancelled as Foreign Affairs Ministry pursues beneficiaries
results.content: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has revoked 10 Service Passports allegedly obtained through an illegal arrangement involving a syndicate operating within the passport administration system.

results.title: There’s no evidence that Ghana’s Diplomatic Passports are being sold – Foreign Ministry
results.content: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has dismissed suggestions that Ghana’s Diplomatic Passports are being sold, insisting that investigations into an alleged passport scandal are strictly focused on Service Passports.

results.title: T-bills auction: Government records 41% oversubscription; but yield on 91-day bill increases
results.content: A little over GH¢3.0 billion of the bids came from the 91-day bill, representing 59% of the total bids. The uptake was about GH¢2.9 billion

results.title: GMA urges gov’t to intensify Ebola preparedness after detection of Bundibugyo strain in Nigeria
results.content: The Ghana Medical Association (GMA) has urged the government to intensify preparations against a possible Ebola outbreak following the reported detection of the Bundibugyo strain of the virus in neighbouring Nigeria.

results.title: GMA proposes dedicated emergency care fund; urges gov’t to explore NHIS, vehicle insurance contributions
results.content: The Ghana Medical Association (GMA) is demanding a dedicated and sustainable funding mechanism for emergency healthcare to ensure patients receive life-saving treatment without financial barriers.

results.title: New DVLA office in Ada to ease vehicle registration, improve road safety
results.content: The Driver and Vehicle Licensing Authority (DVLA) has commissioned a new office at Kasseh in the Ada East District of the Greater Accra Region to bring vehicle registration and licensing services closer to residents.

results.title: Mahama targets $9bn investment to drive economic transformation by 2030
results.content: President John Mahama says his government plans to invest $9 billion in Ghana’s economy between 2027 and 2030 as part of efforts to transform the country’s economic fortunes.

results.title: GMA calls for nationwide expansion of electronic bed management system to end ‘No Bed Syndrome’
results.content: The Ghana Medical Association (GMA) has called for reforms to Ghana’s emergency healthcare system, including the nationwide expansion of the electronic hospital bed management system, to address the persistent problem of patients being turned away from hospitals because of a lack of available beds.

results.title: You should probably be eating more whole grains. Here’s what to do
results.content: The secret is out: Eating whole grains is good for you.

results.title: GJA Awards: Afenyo-Markin calls for repeal of two laws restricting free expression
results.content: Minority Leader Alexander Afenyo-Markin has called for the repeal of Section 208 of the Criminal Offences Act, 1960 (Act 29), and Section 76 of the Electronic Communications Act, 2008 (Act 775), saying that the provisions are being used to criminalise free expression and suppress dissent.

results.title: NDC constituency youth organisers, TEIN delegates file nominations for Okai Mintah
results.content: Constituency Youth Organisers of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), alongside delegates from the Tertiary Education Institutions Network (TEIN), have filed nomination forms for the party’s National Youth Working Committee Chairman, Okai Mintah, to contest for the position of National Youth Organiser.

results.title: Volta Region to benefit greatly from 2027 budget – President Mahama
results.content: President John Mahama says the Volta Region will receive a significant share of the 2027 national budget, with investments expected in agriculture, tourism, textiles, garment manufacturing and hospitality.

results.title: Tempted by snacks before bed? Here’s why – and what you can do about it
results.content: You've eaten dinner, you're comfortably full, and yet half an hour later you're raiding the kitchen cupboards. Sound familiar?

results.title: Employ us or face Jubilee House protest in two weeks – Graduates with disabilities
results.content: The Coalition of Unemployed Graduates with Disabilities has given the Government of Ghana a two-week ultimatum to employ its qualified members in the public sector or secure financial clearance for their recruitment in the upcoming national budget.

results.title: Ghana’s WEAR Ghana and Republic of Africa emerge winners at CANEX Creative Pitch 2026
results.content: Ghanaian creative entrepreneur Awura Abena Agyeman has emerged victorious at the CANEX Creative Pitch 2026 in Lagos, Nigeria, following a presentation on the journey of WEAR Ghana and its evolution into the pan-African cultural enterprise, Republic of Africa.

results.title: Immigration Comptroller-General leads peace talks in Hamile after tragic border clash
results.content: The usually bustling border town of Hamile is on the verge of breathing a sigh of relief as the Comptroller-General of the Ghana Immigration Service (GIS), Samuel Basintale, spearheaded a high-stakes peace dialogue following a deadly explosion and subsequent clashes that brought the town’s economy to its knees.

results.title: Wonder Kutor files for NDC Deputy Communications Officer position
results.content: National Democratic Congress (NDC) National Executive Committee member Wonder Victor Kutor has entered the contest for Deputy National Communications Officer ahead of the party’s December 19, 2026, National Delegates Congress.

results.title: Multimedia Group wins big at 30th GJA Awards
results.content: The Multimedia Group has secured major awards at the 30th Ghana Journalists Association (GJA) Media Awards, with its journalists and programmes earning recognition for excellence in journalism and broadcasting.

results.title: Contract Mining Directive: How Minerals Commission’s push for local content is creating working poor in mining towns in Ghana
results.content: For years, Ghana's mining communities have lived the classic resource curse. Gold is mined in Tarkwa, Obuasi and Kenyasi, but human rights abuses, environmental destruction, loss of livelihoods, health hazards and social decay are what residents say they get in return.

results.title: Mahama earmarks GH¢10m for Media Development Fund in 2027 budget
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has announced a GH¢10 million allocation in the 2027 national budget to provide seed funding for the reactivated Media Development Fund.

results.title: Ato Forson says New Economy will help Ghana attain an investment-grade rating
results.content: Ghana is seeking to secure an investment-grade credit rating through its New Economy programme, a move Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson says will help lower borrowing costs and improve access to long-term financing for local businesses.

results.title: Firefighters contain blaze at scrap storage facility near Circle Railway
results.content: Firefighters have extinguished a fire that broke out at Circle Railway in Accra, preventing it from spreading beyond the affected section of a two-storey building.

results.title: President Mahama urges the church to mentor the youth and support job creation
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has called on professionals, entrepreneurs and artisans in the Assemblies of God, Ghana, to mentor young people and support them to acquire employable skills.

results.title: Sky Train trial: Former GIIF CEO seeks court order to compel 15 persons to testify
results.content: The first accused person in the ongoing Sky Train trial, Solomon Asamoah, has asked the court to compel 15 individuals, including former government officials, directors of the Ghana Infrastructure Investment Fund (GIIF), and financial experts, to testify in his defence.

results.title: Wembley Sports Construction’s Robert Coleman gifts Nathaniel Attoh GHC 50,000
results.content: Wembley Sports Construction Chief Executive Officer Robert Coleman has rewarded JoySports journalist Nathaniel Attoh with GH¢50,000 following his emergence as the 2026 Ghana Journalists Association (GJA) Sports Journalist of the Year.
